text: Stolen JWT lets an attacker impersonate another user.

An unsigned webhook payload alters payment state.
Stored XSS injects malicious script into customer comments.
Administrator actions have no audit trail.
Users can deny transactions because logs lack identity attribution.

A public S3 bucket exposes customer records.
The API writes access tokens and secrets to application logs.

GraphQL has no depth limit and permits resource exhaustion.
